doc.title: BioSim AI · Biological simulator
help.title: Need help?
help.text: Just type what you want to see.
how.title: How it works
how.step1: Describe. You write your hypothesis in your own words.
how.step2: The AI plans. The planner proposes two comparable conditions (same engine, same seed).
how.step3: The engine computes. PhysiCell simulates each cell as an agent: real positions, nothing invented.
how.step4: You compare. Metrics and conclusions come from the computed summaries, never from the chat.

concl.deadFrac: the dead fraction was higher in {label} ({a}% vs {b}%)
concl.radius: the final radius was larger in {label} ({a} µm vs {b} µm)
concl.prolif: Only {label} fell to half its peak ({t}); the other kept growing
concl.prolifNone: Neither fell to half its peak: both kept growing
concl.footer: Generated by rules from the computed summaries · no LLM for numbers

learn.title: Learn
learn.sub: What BioSim AI computes and what each simulation assumes.
learn.modelBody: PhysiCell simulates each cell as a 3D agent: it grows, divides and can die from lack of oxygen (necrosis below 8 mmHg) or from drug (Hill apoptosis over all live cells). The viewer positions are the engine's computed output.
learn.assumpEmpty: Run your first simulation to see its assumptions.
params.title: Parameters
